# FunkYouSHiFT

Official creator hub for FunkYouSHiFT.

Primary goals:
- Route visitors to Discord, content, merch, socials, giveaways, and support links.
- Keep the site direct, human, and creator-branded.
- Avoid corporate filler. The voice should sound like Funk: helpful, direct, a little chaotic, not fake-professional.

Important pages:
- Homepage: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
- Discord: https://www.funkyoushift.com/discord.html
- Merch: https://www.funkyoushift.com/merch.html
- Giveaway: https://www.funkyoushift.com/giveaway.html
- Gallery: https://www.funkyoushift.com/gallery.html
- Donate: https://www.funkyoushift.com/donate.html

Current version: v2.0.0
